# 2 Baruch Chapter 78 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "Thus speaks Baruch the son of Neriah to the brethren who are carried captive; mercy and peace be to you."

**2** "I remember, O my brethren, the love of Him who created us, who loved us from of old, and who never hated us, but above all educated us."

**3** "And truly, I know that all of us who are in the world that now is will be dissolved, for the world itself will be dissolved."

**4** "And the time which now is will not always be here, nor will the seasons of this earth live forever."

**5** "And whatever is now will pass away as a cloud, and as a vapor will it vanish away."

**6** "And the spirit and the soul of every man will return to God who gave it."

**7** "But if a man dies and goes up to the judgment, whatever he has done in this world will be made manifest before the seat of judgment, and there will be examined all his thoughts."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
